component.name: VaultLeaf Backup
component.summary: Friendly encrypted backups and safe file recovery

description.p: VaultLeaf Backup manages encrypted local, network, and cloud backups through a guided GTK interface powered by restic and rclone.
Fixes the VaultLeaf tray, taskbar, dock, and application-menu icons.
Fixes startup on Linux systems with newer GLib application flags.
Adds signed updates and verifiable GitHub build provenance.
Adds native x86-64 and ARM64 releases, verified updates, and safe uninstall.
